title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw a single circle with its center at coordinates (0.002, 0.002) and a radius of 0.002. Apply a scale factor of 0.0041 to the first sketch to adjust its size. Rotate the scaled sketch using Euler angles (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) and translate it using the translation vector (0.0, 0.0, 0.0). Extrude the scaled and transformed sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units, ensuring that no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. Finally, perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object are a length of 0.004076086956521739 units, a width of 0.004076086956521739 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.002, 0.002)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.002)         # Draw a circle with radius 0.002
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75)         # Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
)

# The final model
r = cylinder

# Display the model
